data.title: Careers
data.excerpt: Build systems other people depend on, with a team that values craft, clarity, and continuous learning.

props.headline: Build systems other people depend on.
props.body: Our work is technical, and the result shows up on the floor. If you like real problems, site time, and learning from people who are excellent at their craft, this is a place to grow.

image.alt: Automotive assembly line in a modern factory

props.heading: A working culture that values craft.
props.body:
Do the work

We believe good engineers see the site, understand the operator, and accept that reality rarely matches the drawing.

Clarity is a kindness

We write down assumptions, decisions, and risks because the best teams should not have to guess.

Learn continuously

We provide mentoring, a learning budget, and room to try new things without punishing good failure.

items.title: Technical mentoring
items.description: Work alongside senior engineers on real projects, not only in a classroom.

items.title: Sustainable balance
items.description: We plan work so quality of life and quality of work reinforce each other.

items.title: A visible path
items.description: Competency frameworks and honest career conversations.

items.title: Visible impact
items.description: Your work helps a factory, water network, or energy system run better.

items.title: Senior Automation Engineer
items.summary: Lead the control architecture and commissioning of brownfield automation projects across the Eastern Seaboard.

items.title: Industrial Software Engineer
items.summary: Build operational software that operators actually use, from data model to interface and deployment.

items.title: Project Manager, Infrastructure
items.summary: Run multi-package infrastructure projects with disciplined interfaces, live operations, and a clean handover.

items.title: Data & Analytics Consultant
items.summary: Turn messy operational data into definitions, models, and decisions that survive contact with a real shift.

items.title: HSE Engineer
items.summary: Keep commissioning and live-site work safe without slowing the team down with paperwork theatre.

props.heading: No matching role?
props.body: Introduce yourself anyway. We read every message and will get in touch when there is a good fit.
